stem: Which of the following tool calls would be classified as action tools with real, persistent side effects? (Select 2)

options.text: A tool that cancels a real subscription
A tool that reads and returns the content of a public webpage
A tool that transfers funds between two accounts
A tool that returns the current server timestamp

explanation.why_correct: Canceling a subscription and transferring funds both cause real, persistent changes to external systems -- the defining trait of action tools.

why_incorrect.B: Reading and returning webpage content is a read-only retrieval with no side effect on the webpage or any other system.
why_incorrect.D: Returning a timestamp is a pure information lookup with no side effect.

explanation.rule_of_thumb: Action tools change real external state (cancellations, transfers); information tools only read and return data without changing anything.

stem: A finance-operations agent receives five requests. Which TWO can the model NOT handle reliably from its training knowledge alone, and so should be delegated to a tool? (Select TWO)

options.text: Report the current payment status of one specific customer's invoice stored in the billing system
Compute the exact total of a 240-line invoice with per-line tax rounding
Describe in general terms why companies reconcile their ledgers

explanation.why_correct: The current status of one customer's invoice lives only in the company's billing system and was never part of training data, so it needs a lookup tool. An exact 240-line total with per-line tax rounding is multi-step arithmetic that is far more reliable when the model writes code and a sandboxed interpreter runs it.

why_incorrect.A: Defining an invoice is stable, well-established knowledge that the model can answer without any tool.
why_incorrect.C: Explaining 'net 30' terms is stable, self-contained knowledge that does not depend on current or private data.
why_incorrect.E: A general explanation of why ledgers are reconciled is conceptual, stable knowledge and needs no tool.

explanation.rule_of_thumb: Private system data and exact multi-step computation call for tools; stable general knowledge does not.

stem: A research agent returned four answers with source links. Match each observed problem on the left to its diagnosis on the right. One diagnosis on the right applies to none of the four.

left.text: The linked page is on topic but never mentions the specific figure the answer states
The linked page states the opposite of what the answer claims
The answer is fluent and happens to be correct, but includes no source links
The link is a 2019 page backing a figure that changes every quarter

right.text: Uncited claim: possibly correct, but it cannot be audited
Attribution exists but the source is stale for a fast-changing fact
Unsupported citation: the evidence does not contain the claim
Contradicted citation: the evidence refutes the claim

explanation.why_correct: A linked page that is on topic but never contains the stated figure is an unsupported citation. A page that states the opposite is a contradicted citation. A correct, fluent answer with no links is uncited: it may be right, but nobody can audit it. A 2019 page backing a quarterly-changing figure shows that attribution exists but the source is stale, which is a freshness failure. The fully grounded diagnosis fits none of the four.
explanation.rule_of_thumb: A citation is useful only if the source actually supports the claim and is current enough for the fact.
